items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: Plain, honest steel's poorer cousin.

items.name: Oak Staff
items.description: A walking stick that learned a few tricks.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: Light and quick to draw.

items.name: Iron Mace
items.description: Favoured by priests who expect trouble.

items.name: Steel Sword
items.description: Balanced, sharp, dependable.

items.name: Runed Staff
items.description: Runes along its length hum when spells are cast.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: Reaches across the field.

items.name: Warhammer
items.description: Heavy enough to end arguments, slow enough to start them.

items.name: Spell Saber
items.description: A blade etched for hands that also cast.

items.name: Mithril Blade
items.description: Light as a feather, keen as a rumour.

items.name: Archmage Staff
items.description: Once belonged to someone very important, or so says the seller.

items.name: Elven Bow
items.description: Strung with something finer than gut.

items.name: Holy Mace
items.description: Blessed at the high altar of Kingshold.

items.name: Sunblade
items.description: A sword that remembers the dawn.

items.name: Staff of Ages
items.description: Every wizard who held it left a little of themselves behind.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Boiled leather, patched twice.

items.name: Padded Robe
items.description: Warm, quiet, and full of pockets.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: Rings upon rings; loud but faithful.

items.name: Mage Robes
items.description: Threaded with silver to hold a charge.

items.name: Scout Leathers
items.description: Cut for running, not for standing.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: A walking wall.

items.name: Archmage Vestments
items.description: The embroidery is a spell in itself.

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.description: Hard to see, harder to hit.

items.name: Dragonscale Mail
items.description: Scales shed by something you hope is dead.

items.name: Lucky Charm
items.description: A rabbit's foot. The rabbit disagreed.

items.name: Copper Ring
items.description: Turns your finger green and your skin tougher.

items.name: Ring of Vigor
items.description: Warm to the touch.

items.name: Amulet of Focus
items.description: Quiets the mind before a spell.

items.name: Scholar's Pendant
items.description: Engraved with the motto: keep reading.

items.name: Silver-Tongue Brooch
items.description: Merchants lower their prices without knowing why.

items.name: Band of the Fox
items.description: Sly and quick, like its namesake.

items.name: Sage's Locket
items.description: Holds a lock of a very old philosopher's hair.

items.name: Prayer Beads
items.description: Worn smooth by a hundred hands.

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.description: The temple's sign, blessed and bound in silver.

items.name: Saint's Relic
items.description: A knucklebone of a very patient saint.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.description: Still warm, years after it fell.

items.name: Crown of Whispers
items.description: Everyone listens to whoever wears it.

items.name: Willowbark Tonic
items.description: Bitter bark steeped in cheap wine. Good for coughs, fluxes and fevers.
items.note: Eases a common sickness by one stage.

items.name: Gravewort Poultice
items.description: The priests' dressing for wounds that will not close.
items.note: Eases rot, sores, lockjaw or plague by one stage.

items.name: Physician's Draught
items.description: A guild physician's mixture, sealed with the guild's wax.
items.note: Eases most sicknesses by two stages.

items.name: Salts of Saint Orla
items.description: Blessed salts for the plague-house and the grave-sick.
items.note: Eases rot, plague or the Grey Veil by two stages.

items.name: Smuggler's Theriac
items.description: Forty ingredients, some of them legal. Cures what the black market sells.
items.note: Clears plague, palsy, lockjaw or the Grey Veil outright.

items.name: Nightshade Oil
items.description: A dark oil for a blade's edge. Wash your hands after.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe sickens for 3 turns.

items.name: Wyvern Venom
items.description: Milked from a live wyvern by someone now missing a hand.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe burns with venom for 3 turns.

items.name: Basilisk Bile
items.description: It stiffens whatever it touches, slowly.
items.note: Coats a blade in battle: a struck foe stiffens and weakens for 2 turns.

items.name: Rat-Plague Vial
items.description: Stoppered glass, sealed with wax and a prayer. Throw it, and stand back.
items.note: Thrown in battle: foes sicken and weaken. The thrower may catch it.

items.name: Vial of the Grey Veil
items.description: Grey smoke curls inside the glass, looking for a way out.
items.note: Thrown in battle: foes grey and falter. The thrower may catch it.

items.name: Notched Falchion
items.description: Sharp enough under the rust. The last owner left in a hurry.

items.name: Drowned Man's Staff
items.description: Pulled from a mere with its owner still holding on.

items.name: Dead Man's Hauberk
items.description: Good mail at a third of the price. Mind the stains at the collar.

items.name: Barrow Plate
items.description: Stripped from a barrow-knight. Cheap, and cold to the touch.

items.name: Physician's Robes
items.description: Fine robes, sold once the physician had no more need of them.

items.name: Pawned Amulet
items.description: Silver, still warm from the last neck. The broker will not say whose.
